items.name: Cambridge Challenge 2022

venue.name: Private Residence
venue.address: Address will be provided to registered competitors.

items.information: The only events at this competition will be 3x3x3 Multiple Blindfolded, 3x3x3 Fewest Moves, 4x4x4 Blindfolded, and 5x5x5 blindfolded. First-time competitors are welcome, however we will not be holding the normal speedsolving events, and so you may prefer to attend a different competition. Don't be late! This competition is on the first day of Daylight Savings Time, so make sure you turn your clocks forward so you don't miss the first hour.

items.name: Florida Big & Blind & Time 2022

venue.name: Black Belt Center
venue.details: Venue is a martial arts studio, enter through the double black doors, overflow parking is across the street at Publix

items.information: For Safety Precautions, we ask that competitors and their one guest only be in the venue during the competition's scheduled time. * Please review the COVID precautions tab for information regarding the steps taken to increase competitor safety at this competition. * Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition. * Please review the competitor information tab before the competition. **STAFF** Please contact us if you are interested. You must be able to staff for the entire competition. Staff will pay registration and have it refunded upon completion of staffing for the competition.

items.name: Pittsburgh Winter 2022
items.information: # Competitors may bring at most one guest. This will be checked at the entrance of the competition. No external spectators are allowed, only those coming with a confirmed competitor will be allowed in the venue. # All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof of at least one of the following two requirements to be allowed in the venue: ##### 1) They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after Sunday, February 27th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. ##### **OR** ##### 2) They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than Wednesday, March 9th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. #### ##### Along with a full vaccination or negative test document, a valid ID must be shown and checked at the registration desk on the day of the competition. Any proof sent electronically to the organizers and/or delegates prior to the competition will not be accepted. #####

items.information: #The competition has been cancelled due to the ongoing Russo-Ukrainian War.# ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbFlUIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8c1308d4d128f8bd97e1f01af0a568aca1847fb6/undefined%20-%20Imgur.png) * Один участник может взять с собой **максимум 1 гостя**. Необходимо внести имя и фамилию гостя в комментарии при регистрации на соревнования на сайте WCA; * Допуск на место проведения соревнований для участников и гостей будет происходить по документам: * Для участников и гостей младше 18 лет: **документ**, удостоверяющий личность (паспорт или свидетельство о рождении); * Для участников и гостей от 18 лет: **QR-код** сертификата вакцинированного против новой коронавирусной инфекции COVID-19 либо перенесшего новую коронавирусную инфекцию COVID-19 (с даты выздоровления прошло не более 6 календарных месяцев) либо **отрицательный результат ПЦР-тестирования** на выявление возбудителя новой коронавирусной инфекции COVID-19, проведенный не более чем за 72 часа до начала мероприятия или не более чем за 48 часов до въезда на территорию Республики Коми. Больше информации в [группе ВКонтакте](https://vk.com/syktyvkaropen2022) и [вкладке "Особенности, связанные с COVID-19"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SyktyvkarOpen2022#17090-covid-19-covid-19-measures). ________________________________________ * One competitor can bring **only 1 guest** with them. You should add your guest’s full name to your registration comments; * Competitors and guests must present the following documents to enter the venue: * For competitors and guests under the age of 18: valid national **ID document**; * For competitors and guests over 18 years old: **QR-code** of full COVID-19 vaccination or recent recovery (at most 6 month) or **negative for COVID-19** within 72 hours of the competition or within 48 hours before entry in Komi Republic. More information on the [competition website](https://vk.com/syktyvkaropen2022) and in [COVID-19 Measures tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SyktyvkarOpen2022#17090-covid-19-covid-19-measures).
